entries.title: Psalms 105:1
segments: ¶O give praise to the Lord; give honour to his name, talking of his doings among the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 105:2
segments: Let your voice be sounding in songs and melody; let all your thoughts be of the wonder of his works.

entries.title: Psalms 105:3
segments: Have glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who are searching after the Lord be glad.

entries.title: Psalms 105:4
segments: Let your search be for the Lord and for his strength; let your hearts ever be turned to him.

entries.title: Psalms 105:5
segments: Keep in mind the great works which he has done; his wonders, and the decisions of his mouth;

entries.title: Psalms 105:6
segments: O you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his loved ones.

entries.title: Psalms 105:7
segments: He is the Lord our God: he is judge of all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 105:8
segments: ¶He has kept his agreement in mind for ever, the word which he gave for a thousand generations;

entries.title: Psalms 105:9
segments: The agreement which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;

entries.title: Psalms 105:10
segments: And he gave it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an eternal agreement;

entries.title: Psalms 105:11
segments: Saying, To you will I give the land of Canaan, the measured line of your heritage:

entries.title: Psalms 105:12
segments: When they were still small in number, and strange in the land;

entries.title: Psalms 105:13
segments: When they went about from one nation to another, and from one kingdom to another people.

entries.title: Psalms 105:14
segments: He would not let anyone do them wrong; he even kept back kings because of them,

entries.title: Psalms 105:15
segments: Saying, Put not your hand on those who have been marked with my holy oil, and do my prophets no wrong.

entries.title: Psalms 105:16
segments: And he took away all food from the land, so that the people were without bread.

entries.title: Psalms 105:17
segments: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was given as a servant for a price:

entries.title: Psalms 105:18
segments: His feet were fixed in chains; his neck was put in iron bands;

entries.title: Psalms 105:19
segments: Till the time when his word came true; he was tested by the word of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 105:20
segments: The king sent men to take off his chains; even the ruler of the people, who let him go free.

entries.title: Psalms 105:21
segments: He made him lord of his house, and ruler over everything he had;

entries.title: Psalms 105:22
segments: To give his chiefs teaching at his pleasure, and so that his law-givers might get wisdom from him.

entries.title: Psalms 105:23
segments: Then Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob was living in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:24
segments: And his people were greatly increased, and became stronger than those who were against them.

entries.title: Psalms 105:25
segments: ¶Their hearts were turned to hate against his people, so that they made secret designs against them.

entries.title: Psalms 105:26
segments: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, the man of his selection.

entries.title: Psalms 105:27
segments: He let his signs be seen among the people, and his wonders in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:28
segments: He sent black night and made it dark; and they did not go against his word.

entries.title: Psalms 105:29
segments: At his word their waters were turned to blood, and he sent death on all their fish.

entries.title: Psalms 105:30
segments: Their land was full of frogs, even in the rooms of the king.

entries.title: Psalms 105:31
segments: He gave the word, and there came the dog-fly, and insects over all the land.

entries.title: Psalms 105:32
segments: He gave them ice for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

entries.title: Psalms 105:33
segments: He gave their vines and their fig-trees to destruction, and the trees of their land were broken down.

entries.title: Psalms 105:34
segments: At his word the locusts came, and young locusts more than might be numbered,

entries.title: Psalms 105:35
segments: And put an end to all the plants of their land, taking all the fruit of the earth for food.

entries.title: Psalms 105:36
segments: He put to death the first child of every family in the land, the first-fruits of their strength.

entries.title: Psalms 105:37
segments: He took his people out with silver and gold: there was not one feeble person among them.

entries.title: Psalms 105:38
segments: Egypt was glad when they went; for the fear of them had come down on them.

entries.title: Psalms 105:39
segments: A cloud was stretched over them for a cover; and he sent fire to give light in the night.

entries.title: Psalms 105:40
segments: At the people's request he sent birds, and gave them the bread of heaven for food.

entries.title: Psalms 105:41
segments: His hand made the rock open, and the waters came streaming out; they went down through the dry places like a river.

entries.title: Psalms 105:42
segments: For he kept in mind his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

entries.title: Psalms 105:43
segments: And he took his people out with joy, the men of his selection with glad cries:

entries.title: Psalms 105:44
segments: And gave them the lands of the nations; and they took the work of the peoples for a heritage;

entries.title: Psalms 105:45
segments: So that they might keep his orders, and be true to his laws. Give praise to the Lord.
